title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Pass Waiver Charge on Window Refunds
content:
# Pass waiver charge on window refunds — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

When a Wayfare Pass period fee is refunded under the full refund window, the Pass waiver charge counts the Pass fee waivers recorded on the member's trips in the last month and values each at 3.75 on the Plus Monthly, Plus Annual and All Access Annual plans and at 2.50 on the Monthly and Annual plans; waivers on the Student plan are not counted. The Pass waiver charge, the count multiplied by the value per waiver, is withheld from the window refund.

| Plan the membership is on | Value per Pass fee waiver (USD) |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 3.75 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 3.75 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 3.75 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 2.50 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 2.50 |
| Wayfare Pass Student | not counted |

**Records counted.** Fee waiver entries on the member's trip charges in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) that carry this Wayfare Pass membership, dated in the last month: free cancellations, Priority Pickup waivers, reservation fee waivers and any other Pass waiver recorded there.

**Figures (hypothetical).**

| Plan | Pass fee waivers in the last month | Pass waiver charge |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 3 | 11.25 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 2 | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Student | 4 | nothing |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 0 | nothing |
